title: Phone storage full
symptom: Phone says storage is full and apps stop working
user_description: My phone says storage is full. I can't take photos or update apps, and the email app is acting strange.

options.why: Erases everything. Storage problems are fixed by freeing space, not by wiping the phone.

options.text: Delete the email app to free space
options.why: Removes his access to work mail and does not solve the real cause.

options.text: Check what uses the storage, clear unneeded apps, caches and large downloads, and back up photos to an approved cloud service before deleting them
options.why: Seeing what takes space shows the real cause. Backing up photos before deleting avoids losing anything he wants to keep.
Expensive and avoidable. Storage can almost always be freed up.

hints: What takes up the most space on a phone?
What must you do before deleting photos?
Which apps must you not remove?
real_world_tip: Photos and videos are the usual cause. Show him how to see storage by category.
